# Prayer House Ministry International (Solution Center)
> A Spirit-filled prophetic church in Mile 4, Limbe, Cameroon.

Prayer House Ministry International, also known as Solution Center, is a local church in Limbe, South West Region, Cameroon. It was founded in 2024 by Rev. Apostle E.S. Hugo and is co-led with Prophetess Ekwalla Calista. The house exists to raise lives through prayer, worship, and the Word. This is not the Canada-registered organization that shares a similar name.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — church overview, service times, ministries, giving, and contact

- /ministries: Prayer, Worship, Youth, Women, Outreach, and Choir
- /sermons: Messages from the Limbe pulpit
- /events: Upcoming services and conferences
- /blog: Devotionals and teaching articles
- /faq: Frequently asked questions about visiting and church life
- /glossary: Definitions of ministry terms (Solution Center, prophetic church, house of prayer)
- /contact: Address, phone, and contact form
- /gallery: Photos from worship and community life
